posts.meta_description:
3,594 likes, 384 comments - abybaig on November 2, 2025: "Awarded Best Travel Photographer of the Year by @TimesofIndia 🙏✨

This happened last evening!
Photography has been taking me to places I never even imagined. Nothing, just thankful to God for putting that rebel instinct inside me, that made me choose this art, even when the world told me not to.

There’s a special kind of joy when life rewards you for something you’ve given your whole self to. Honestly, after stepping into photography, I never chased opportunities, never went asking for work, never ran after numbers. I just kept doing my work with honesty, passion, and pure intention, and everything else started falling into place on its own.

Thank you to every single person who gave me even a little bit of courage along this journey, There’s still a long way to go.

And to all my fellow photographers, especially those just starting out, I know the beginning feels tough. You’ll face hurdles from all sides. But always trust your work, stay honest to your art, and keep putting your heart into it. Your work will take you to places you can’t even imagine today.

What’s meant for you will always find its way ❤️✨

.
.
.
#abybaig #Travelpowercreators2025
Journey, Photography, Photographer, Artist, Art, Award, Times of India, Travel, Travel photographer".

posts.meta_description:
1,762 likes, 97 comments - abybaig on September 10, 2026: "Some places become part of your story long before you realise it..

I was 12 when I first saw the Taj Mahal with my father. I was too young to understand its history, but old enough to be moved by its beauty.. Years later, when I began my journey as a photographer, it became one of the first subjects I chose to chase.

I have photographed it countless times, across seasons and through different stages of my life. Yet every return feels like the first time, only I have changed :)

This time, @radissonhotels brought my story and the Taj together in a way that felt deeply personal.. A beautiful concept by The Tie Media, brought to life by Pankaj as DOP, with the script written by me ❤️

Concept - @thetiemedia 
DOP - @pankaj_sahoo 
Screenwriting - @abybaig 

.
.
.

#abybaig
Journey, Art, Photography, Story, Life, Taj Mahal, Agra".

1,702 likes, 67 comments - abybaig on August 20, 2026: "Been shooting with the vivo X300 FE for a while now, and this time I took it to the Old Delhi to test its dedicated Street Photography Mode.

The street photography mode delivers excellent shutter response, well-balanced contrast, and consistent colour science across multiple focal lengths. The results have that authentic street aesthetic with natural tones and a cinematic feel straight out of the camera.

Here are a few moments from my last visit 🎬

.
.
.
.
#Ad #vivoX300FE #MyCityVibes #vivoIndia".

18K likes, 266 comments - abybaig on August 19, 2026: "Dear Photography,

It’s been 13 years since you chose me, and it’s been an honour serving you ❤️

You’ve seen every version of me, my sleepless nights, my tears, my triumphs, loneliness, my hunger for stories, and the quiet moments no one ever saw.. You’ve seen me change, lose, grow, and find pieces of myself along the way. 

Thank you for staying through it all, for giving meaning to my journey, and for becoming a part of who I am.

Happy World Photography Day to y’all..

Keep creating, Keep seeing, Keep your originality alive ❤️📸

.
.
.
.
.

#abybaig
Artist, Photographer, Journey, Photography, Life, Story, Document, Travel, Wander, Creative, Vision, Solitude, Time, Memory, Becoming".
